At DSO 6d002db2 (the PFP-6 artefact, reproduced from clean staging 05ee177a3) the two exponentiations are 89.4% of the refresh-free private operation (577 of 645.7 us; 16.3M of 18.22M instructions), and the kernel retires IPC 4.62 of a 6-wide machine at 1,399 cycles per Montgomery multiplication. The only positive ceiling is the issue-width floor (6457/6 instructions -> 1.30x kernel, 1.26x op), which needs IPC 6.0; the measured fused loop costs 1.1132x [1.1102, 1.1151] per multiplication (1.0183x on an ADX build; slower in every run, faster in none), so the attainable change is 0.91x. No source changed. Protection verified at the digest: each CRT half and the recombination are caught by the result check with blinding on and off; the deterministic differential is byte-identical on 4,185 lines including 16 zero-length synthetic answers; ctgrind shows no ladder-carrier site and the branch audit no secret-derived transfer.
